totals.identity_disclosure: Identity disclosure: with only full-season club rates captured, possessions x points-per-possession and the sum of the two clubs' scoring averages agree to within rounding, because the official off rating IS 100 * points / possessions. The formula is still the model - it is the correct object - but on season-wide inputs it cannot differ from the naive sum. The two diverge only with opponent-specific points per possession, which needs per-game logs this repo does not hold. Published rather than papered over.
